subject: POC capacity planning - VenturoTech (next steps & success criteria)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@venturotech.ai>, Samira Noor <samira@venturotech.ai>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC capacity planning - VenturoTech (next steps & success criteria)

Hi Alex / Samira —

Thanks again for the chat today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we all have the same expectations ahead of the POC. Please flag anything I've missed.

Summary of call:
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency chat + batch reranking for VenturoTech's customer support assistant.
- Key success criteria: average 95th percentile latency < 250ms for chat flows at target QPS, embedding similarity recall within 2% of baseline, and acceptable cost-per-conversation threshold (TBD).

Proposed POC framework (2 weeks):
- Timeline: Kickoff week of May 18, 2026 — run May 18 to May 31 (flexible by a day if needed).
- Baseline capacity: reserve 2 GPUs (A100 equivalent) for consistent throughput.
- Autoscaling: allow burst up to 4 GPUs for peak traffic with scale-up within 10 minutes (we can tighten this if needed) and automatic scale-down after 15 minutes of low load.
- Pre-warming & KV cache: we will pre-warm top prefixes and prime KV caches for the 3 highest-volume flows to keep cold-start latency low.
- Monitoring & success measurement: we will instrument per-route latency, token cost, and an embedding quality sample set you provide.

Ownership:
- Redwood: Marissa (sales, project lead) + Mateo (infrastructure lead) + Vivek (solutions/CS).
- VenturoTech: Alex (technical lead) + Samira (product owner).

Next steps / Asks for VenturoTech:
1) Confirm success criteria above and add any missing metrics (cost thresholds, regulatory constraints).
2) Confirm POC start date (we're proposing Mon May 18) and preferred kickoff time.
3) Share a small sample dataset and the embedding evaluation checklist (we'll only use anonymized/test data during the POC).
4) Approve the capacity plan (reserve 2 GPUs, autoscale to 4) or tell us desired baseline/burst so we can update the quote.

Attachments: venturotech_poc_requirements.pdf (summary of what we discussed), redwood-dedicated-quote.xlsx (estimates for reserved capacity and burst pricing).

Thanks — looking forward to getting the POC kicked off.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@venturotech.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Noor <samira@venturotech.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC capacity planning - VenturoTech (next steps & success criteria)

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and summarizes the call well. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Success criteria: we agree on the latency and embedding recall goals. For cost, can we target a soft ceiling (for the POC) of $0.08 per convo? We can tighten later.
- Capacity: our traffic pattern has short but very spiky peaks during batch runs. Can we increase the burst to 6 GPUs for short windows (5-15 minutes) if needed? We'll cover the incremental cost for bursts during the POC.
- Security/regulatory: we need to make sure logs are retained per our policy; I'll loop in our security contact if any evidence/attestations are necessary.

Kickoff: May 18 works for us — can we do 10:00 AM PT?

Also happy to send a small anonymized sample dataset by Monday.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Chen | Head of ML Engineering, VenturoTech
alex.chen@venturotech.ai

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@venturotech.ai>, Samira Noor <samira@venturotech.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC capacity planning - VenturoTech (next steps & success criteria)

Marissa / team —

Quick infra read on the ask: VenturoTech's spike profile means we should be more conservative on reserved baseline to avoid repeated scale events. My recommendation:
- Reserve 4 GPUs baseline (A100-equivalent) to keep the 95th percentile latency stable for chat and background reranking.
- Autoscale policy: allow bursts up to 8 GPUs. Use a 30-second pre-warm handshake for model shards and a 5-15 minute autoscale window based on metric thresholds to avoid oscillation.
- Pre-warm approach: we will pre-load common prompts and the top-3 KV entries, plus a warmup traffic generator that simulates the peak flows for the first 10 minutes after scale-up.

I'll attach a short cost delta estimate and the autoscale config template to the shared Drive (see link in the related_links field). If VenturoTech is OK with covering burst costs during the POC, we can start with the 4->8 plan.

- Mateo
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@venturotech.ai>, Samira Noor <samira@venturotech.ai>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC capacity planning - VenturoTech (next steps & success criteria)

Alex / Samira —

Thanks for the quick replies and the detail, Alex — and thanks Mateo for the infra plan.

Confirming updated plan and next steps: 
1) Capacity: reserve 4 GPUs baseline (A100-equivalent), autoscale up to 8 GPUs for short bursts. We'll implement the 30s pre-warm and the 5-15 minute autoscale window Mateo suggested.
2) Cost: VenturoTech covers incremental burst cost during the POC. Mateo will share the cost delta estimate by EOD today.
3) Security: Alex, please loop in your security contact for any evidence requests; we'll be prepared to provide SOC 2 summary and logs via the Private connector if needed.
4) Timeline & kickoff: Kickoff scheduled for Tue, May 18, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT — calendar invite and agenda to follow.
5) Owners:
   - Redwood: Marissa (project lead / sales), Mateo (infra), Vivek (solutions/CS)
   - VenturoTech: Alex (technical lead), Samira (product owner)

Action items for VenturoTech: share anonymized sample dataset and confirm security contact by Mon May 11 EOD.

DocuSign/setup link: https://app.redwood.ai/poc-setup/VT-2026-0531 (please sign so we can provision dedicated capacity).

If that all looks right, we'll send the calendar invite and provisioning request to start pre-warming a day before kickoff.

Thanks — excited to get this running.

Best,
Marissa
